headline: Revenue, profit, and EPS all climb sharply
summary_short: Siemens Energy India reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of ₹24,856M, up 3.8% q/q and 39.3% y/y, with EPS of ₹12.38 up 17.7% q/q and 67.8% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue of ₹24,856M rose 3.8% sequentially and 39.3% year-over-year. Operating income of ₹8,016M rose 18.9% q/q and 68.3% y/y; net income of ₹4,409M rose 17.7% q/q and 67.8% y/y. EPS of ₹12.38 rose in step, up 17.7% q/q and 67.8% y/y. These are the only KPIs carried on the shard for this period; no margin or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
